legal.disclaimer: The articles on this site are educational publications. They are not a medical consultation, diagnosis or treatment plan, and they do not create a doctor–patient relationship. Decisions about your own care should be made with a clinician who knows your history.
legal.privacy: This site stores account details you choose to provide, newsletter consent, and anonymous reading analytics such as page views and referrers. It does not collect patient records. Passwords are stored only as hashes. You may request correction of your account name or unsubscribe from email at any time.
legal.terms: You may read and share published articles with attribution. Comments must be lawful, must not include identifiable patient information, and may be removed. Accounts that abuse the site can be restricted. The administrator reviews medical translations before they are published.
